scientific_limitations: The noise support is the full closed Euclidean disk and the matrix has two distinct positive diagonal contraction factors 0<a<b<1.
Regularity is geometric C2 boundary regularity; the normal-angle support function need not be C2 at zero-curvature tips.
No statement is made for nonlinear persistence, non-ball supports or general nondiagonal matrices.
Database indexing and inaccessible or unindexed papers leave a publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp curvature transition and log-periodic flattening of planar bounded-noise attractors
